title.purpose: Section headings on the sheet and in the directory.

body.purpose: Prose in the 68ch column. The lede is 1.125rem.

label.purpose: Copy, Menu, and other controls. Figtree, weight 600, line-height 1.

shadows.name: current-section
shadows.purpose: Hairline under the current masthead section. Not elevation.

motion.name: copy-label
motion.purpose: How long Copy reads Copied or Selected before it returns to Copy.

components.name: Copy
components.description: Filled control on a command row. The label is the word Copy; it reads Copied or Selected for 2.4s.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--ink); color: var(--sheet); font: 600 0.95rem/1 "Figtree", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 1rem; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #000000; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Menu
components.description: Masthead control from 720px down. Opens the stacked section links.
components.css: .ds-btn-menu { border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--sheet); color: var(--ink); font: 600 0.95rem/1 "Figtree", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 0.85rem; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-menu:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Command row
components.description: A ruled row for a command you can copy. The monospace command sits beside Copy.
components.css: .ds-command { display: flex; align-items: stretch; gap: 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--sheet); padding: 0.45rem 0.45rem 0.45rem 1rem; } .ds-command code { flex: 1; align-self: center; font-family: ui-monospace, "SFMono-Regular", Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.92rem; white-space: nowrap; color: var(--ink); } .ds-command-copy { border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--ink); color: var(--sheet); font: 600 0.95rem/1 "Figtree", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 1rem; cursor: pointer; } .ds-command-copy:hover { background: #000000; } .ds-command-copy:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Masthead
components.description: Sticky white bar. The constellation mark, the section links, and the current section as weight plus a hairline.
components.html: AI MaestroStartGuidesEcosystem
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem 1.5rem; min-height: 4.25rem; padding: 0.65rem 1.25rem; background: var(--sheet); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); font-family: "Figtree", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-nav .ds-mark { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.65rem; color: var(--ink); text-decoration: none; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.03em; font-size: 1.05rem; } .ds-nav .ds-mark svg { display: block; width: 28px; height: 28px; } .ds-nav a { color: var(--ink); text-decoration: none; font-size: 0.98rem; } .ds-nav a:hover { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 0.22em; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-nav a[aria-current] { font-weight: 650; box-shadow: inset 0 -1px 0 var(--ink); text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav .ds-split { margin-left: auto; color: var(--ink-soft); }

components.name: Place line
components.description: The line under the masthead on a guide or long-form page. Section link, a middle dot, then the page name.
components.css: .ds-place { margin: 0; padding: 0.45rem 1.25rem; background: var(--sheet); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--ink-soft); font-size: 0.92rem; font-family: "Figtree", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-place a { color: var(--ink); text-underline-offset: 0.18em; } .ds-place a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Directory row
components.description: One row of the wayfinding list. The page name and a short description, ruled top and bottom.
components.html:
• One computer

    Several agents on the machine in front of you.
components.css: .ds-dir { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); font-family: "Figtree", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-dir li { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(11rem, 16rem) 1fr; gap: 0.35rem 1.5rem; align-items: baseline; padding: 0.8rem 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); } .ds-dir a { font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink); text-decoration: none; } .ds-dir a:hover { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 0.18em; } .ds-dir a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-dir p { margin: 0; color: var(--ink-soft); }

components.name: Code sample
components.description: A square ruled sample, labeled as an example. It is not the command row.
components.html:
Example, not the output of a run on this page

Dashboard
http://localhost:23000
components.css: .ds-example-label { margin: 0 0 0.4rem; font-weight: 650; font-family: "Figtree", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; color: var(--ink); } .ds-example { margin: 0; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--sheet); padding: 0.9rem 1rem; overflow-x: auto; font-family: ui-monospace, "SFMono-Regular", Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.9rem; color: var(--ink); }

components.name: Skip link
components.description: Shown as focused. At rest it sits off the page, translated up by 150%, and returns on focus.
components.css: .ds-skip { background: var(--ink); color: var(--sheet); padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; text-decoration: none; font-family: "Figtree", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-skip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
This file is the visual system for the public docs site in `docs/`, served as aimaestro.sh. PRODUCT.md describes the person who runs the dashboard at localhost:23000. That dashboard is a different surface. A later change to the app does not inherit this sheet as the app theme.

The site reads as a wayfinding sheet. The ground is warm paper. White is the sheet that sits on it: the masthead, the place line, the command, the code sample, and the home footer. Ink is charcoal. Type is Figtree. Regions meet on a gray hairline. The constellation mark sits in the masthead, taken from the existing file. The section you are in is heavier type plus a hairline. A command is a ruled row with the word Copy.

Guide pages (`body.docs-legacy`) and the long-form assistant page (`body.docs-read`) keep their articles inside this frame: the same masthead, the same place line, the same ink and type. The article already on the one-computer page stays there. The frame is what a new docs surface copies.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper ground, with white sheets for the masthead, place line, command, code sample, and home footer
Figtree for the frame and the prose; ui-monospace for code
One-pixel hairlines; the current section is heavier type plus an inset charcoal rule
A 68ch reading column and a 60rem directory
Copy is a charcoal button on the command row; the designed motion is that button’s label
The existing constellation file, shown at 28px, is the mark

rules.name: The Docs Sheet Rule
rules.body: This system is the public docs site in `docs/` (aimaestro.sh). It is not the theme of the localhost dashboard.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: A region is separated by a 1px line. The section you are in is weight 650 and an inset 1px charcoal rule. A colored pill is not a state.

rules.name: The Mark File Rule
rules.body: `docs/logo-constellation.svg` keeps the blue and violet already drawn in that file. Those hues are not tokens, and new surfaces do not pick them up as accents.

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: Figtree carries prose, navigation, and controls. Code uses ui-monospace. Syne, DM Sans, and JetBrains Mono remain named inside old guide pages and are not this ramp.

rules.name: The Tight Title Rule
rules.body: A frame title is weight 600 and tracks at -0.035em, with no eyebrow above it.

rules.name: The Measure Rule
rules.body: Prose stays in 68ch. The directory stays in 60rem. The gutter stays 1.25rem.

rules.name: The Flat Sheet Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat. The only box-shadow in the frame is the inset 1px rule under the current masthead link.

rules.name: The Square-Enough Rule
rules.body: Interactive controls use a 6px radius. The command row uses 8px. Text regions and rules stay square.

rules.name: The Command Row Rule
rules.body: A command is one ruled row: the command in monospace, Copy as the charcoal button. A blocked clipboard selects the command.

dos: Do paint the ground Warm Paper and the masthead, place line, command, code sample, and home footer Sheet White.
Do mark the current section with weight 650 and an inset 1px Charcoal Ink rule.
Do set frame titles in Figtree at weight 600 and letter-spacing -0.035em, inside a 68ch column, with code in ui-monospace.
Do use `docs/logo-constellation.svg` at 28×28. Leave the file as it is.
Do keep Copy at least 2.75rem tall, with a 2px Charcoal Ink focus outline offset 3px.
Do build a new docs index as the sheet plus the directory, and leave a kept guide article inside the frame.
donts: Don't use this sheet as the localhost dashboard theme.
Don't use a drop shadow, a colored pill, or a chromatic accent as a state.
Don't put an eyebrow above a frame title.
Don't reuse the kept articles’ card grids, pills, emoji, or social glyphs as components.
Don't add a generated raster to the site. Files under `.impeccable/review` and `/opt/cursor/artifacts` are review evidence, not pages.
Don't take a theme color from the indigo, emerald, or navy values still left in some `theme-color` meta tags and in `docs/site.webmanifest`.
